acceptanceCriteria: anchorRow reads the note blob from the captured notes commit by object ID (noteBlobAt), not through the ref
A test moves the ref A->B->A around the read and shows only A's content is reported
Mutation check: reverting to the ref read fails the test
body: The CEM-V1-345 verdict-ledger read was fixed (batch-cem-batch, f67bf4f57) to read the captured tip by object ID. The --notes-tip path for refs/notes/corvint (anchorRow via noteBlob(Ref), CEM-V1-067, V1-1260) has the same shape: it captures the tip, then reads through the ref. If another process moves the ref A->B->A between the capture and requireUnmoved, B's note content can be reported against tip A. Found by the CEM lane while fixing the Codex finding; not reproduced.
